summary: Comprehensive testing of Government File Tracking System completed. Backend: 38/38 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All critical flows tested successfully including login, dashboard, file management, and role-based navigation.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ All API endpoints use proper authentication and authorization
✅ MongoDB _id properly excluded from all responses
✅ All interactive elements have testID attributes for testing
✅ React Native components used correctly (View, Text, TouchableOpacity)
✅ No hardcoded URLs - all from environment variables
✅ File submission locks file and creates department approvals
✅ Audit logging implemented for all major actions

success_rate.frontend: 95% (All critical flows working, minor React Native alert interaction limitation in automated tests)

seed_data_creation: 15 default users seeded on backend startup. Test data created during pytest runs (prefixed with TEST_) is cleaned between test runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend APIs fully functional. Frontend loads correctly with role-based login (4 categories). File creation, submission, and approval workflows tested. Password reset requires creating temporary test users to avoid affecting default credentials. React Native web alerts cannot be automated with Playwright - manual testing recommended for alert confirmations.

test_categories.authentication: 12 tests - All roles login successfully (admin, caseworker, 9 tahsildars, sp, forest, adc, dc)
test_categories.file_crud: 9 tests - Create, edit, list, detail, submit, permission checks
test_categories.approval_workflow: 7 tests - Tahsildar, SP, Forest (with N/A), ADC remarks, DC accept/reject decisions
test_categories.admin_operations: 7 tests - Analytics, user management, password reset, audit logs, credentials list
test_categories.notifications: 3 tests - Get notifications, unread count, mark as read
